name: Auras
overview: The concept of auras, while not explicitly named in Scripture, can be reflected in the vivid visions of God's glory and presence, such as Ezekiel's encounter where the heavens opened and living creatures moved with accompanying wheels (Ezekiel 1:1, 1:19). This imagery points to the divine majesty and spiritual realities beyond human sight. The eternal Word, who was with God and was God from the beginning (John 1:1), is the source of all light and life, underscoring that any spiritual radiance originates from Christ alone. The unity of believers at Pentecost (Acts 2:1) further reveals the Spirit's work in manifesting God's presence among His people, not through human-generated phenomena but through divine revelation and fellowship.
